invsbw.desc: A short hunting bow: a single stave of weathered brown wood whose two limbs mirror each other around a leather-wrapped grip exactly at the middle, both limb tips ending in identical pale horn nocks, and a thick pale tan twine bowstring clearly visible running straight from tip to tip, so the bow is shaped like a capital letter D. Shown upright, side view.
